basic_info.description: Transparent pricing! Buy it now with no-muss-no-fuss. "Charmer" is an overused word, and so is "Potential", but this time both words are really true! Hidden behind an arched gate, 150 Kingston has a garden setting and the kind of architecture that will make you feel like you're living in Provence. With an unusual side entrance and shuttered windows, there's even a Juliet balcony above the front door so you can greet your guests with a bit of panache. On the main level, a living room invites you to curl up with a book, while the efficient kitchen has a dining nook and window framed by greenery. Upstairs, the main bedroom is large enough for a king size bed, while the second bedroom sits adjacent to a lovely remodeled bath. Back outside your living space is extended with a flagstone patio perfect for your morning coffee, quiet afternoons, and dinners that linger into twilight. When you're ready, there are also two sets of architectural plans with bids to expand the kitchen/living room or take the home all the way to a three bedroom residence.
